desc: Derive the combinatorial factor C(m*n - 2, k - 2) modulo MOD, including handling k=2 and precomputing factorials/inverses up to m*n.
Derive a formula for T(L) = sum of |i-j| over all unordered pairs in {0,...,L-1} = (L^3-L)/6, and verify small cases.
Express the total Manhattan distance over all cell pairs as n^2 * T(m) + m^2 * T(n).
Implement the full solution: precompute factorials/inverses, compute C(N-2,k-2) and (n^2*T(m)+m^2*T(n)) mod MOD, return product.
Verify the sample tests (2,2,2)->8 and (1,4,3)->20, plus boundaries k=2 and k=m*n.
